tools.name: Optimize agent
tools.detail: Nightly meta-agent that audits other agents' instructions and permissions, fixes safe issues, queues sensitive changes for approval

claims: Three agents helped him make $50k last month

Email sales agent: searches his email list for highest-value prospects, researches their business, sends personalized email, handles the whole conversation, qualifies, books calls on his calendar while he sleeps
Client success agents: every client call is fed in; they track what was discussed, onboarding setup, whether agreed items are implemented; flag slippage early
Optimize agent: every night audits Jarvis and all agents for outdated info, conflicting instructions, broken permissions; fixes safe issues, leaves sensitive changes waiting for approval
on_screen_only: Slide 'STEP 1 Email Sales Agent: Finds prospects - top leads only; Sends outreach - personalized, automatic; Books the call - straight to my calendar. While I'm asleep, it's filling my calendar with qualified sales calls. SELLS WHILE YOU SLEEP'

Slide 'STEP 2 Client Success Agent: Fed every call - tracks what was discussed; Tracks setup - how the client is being onboarded; Flags slippage - catches issues before they escalate. NEVER DROPS THE BALL'

Slide 'STEP 3 Optimize Agent: Nightly audit - every agent, checked; Finds issues - outdated, broken, conflicting; Fixes safely - sensitive changes wait for you. Employing AI agents means they don't need you prompting every step. THE NIGHT SHIFT'
Intro b-roll of a multi-monitor setup with '$50k.' caption

relevance.why: No tooling or method shown, pure funnel. The one transferable idea is a scheduled meta-agent that audits other agents' instructions/permissions and queues risky changes for approval, which fits Haji's routines and skills-maintenance problem.

implement_score.why: Could implement a weekly Claude Code routine that lints CLAUDE.md/skills/routines for contradictions and stale facts and opens a PR for approval; cheap. Sales/CS agents require CRM/email wiring and cold-outreach appetite Haji has not signaled.

verify: Any evidence for the $50k claim or what 'Jarvis' is built on (Hermes? custom?)
How the client-success agent ingests calls (transcription tool?) and where data lives
Whether the 'Optimize' agent is real or marketing framing

gap.what: Lead-gen with no how-to; liked set already has Jarvis recipes, email/CS agents and on-call auditing agents. Only novel framing: a nightly agent that audits other agents' instructions and permissions.
